questions.a: The ب has a sukoon: a small bounce, al-ab(b)-raar.

questions.q: Qalqalah hunt (pupil PDF): find every qalqalah letter with a sukoon in 83:13 to 18 and at the ayah ends of 83:1 to 18. Today's rota group recites 83:13 to 18.
questions.a: Mid-word: ب in ٱلْأَبْرَارِ (83:18). The ayah ends of 83:1 to 18 end in ن or م, so there is no large qalqalah there.

questions.q: Extend: give the memory phrase and one example of large qalqalah from At-Tariq.
questions.a: قُطْبُ جَدٍّ; ٱلثَّاقِبُ at a stop (86:3).

questions.q: Stretch: why do these five letters need qalqalah?
questions.a: They are jahr and shiddah: breath and sound both stop, so without a bounce they would not be heard.

questions.q: Which word has a qalqalah letter with a sukoon?
questions.a: A) ٱلْأَبْرَارِ. In ٱلْأَبْرَارِ the ب has a sukoon: qalqalah. The others have no qalqalah letter with a sukoon.
when we stop on the letter
options: when we stop on the letter
in the middle of a word

questions.q: Think again: Throw a ball gently against a wall. What happens? How might a letter 'bounce'?
questions.a: It bounces back. Qalqalah letters with a sukoon make a small echo so they are not swallowed.
